title: Radioactive Bananas
script: You're consuming radiation daily! Bananas hold a radioactive secret. Potassium is the culprit behind their glow. But that's not even the strange part. Millions of bananas would be needed to see an effect! A naturally occurring isotope is the reason why. This isotope is a radioactive form of potassium. Eating millions at once is the only way it matters. The risk is extremely low with normal consumption. Share this fact about bananas being slightly radioactive!
